answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 100 slots and runs one bidding pulse. Applicants bid on one of three terrace tiers — 50/150/400 POA; top bids win, losers refunded. A newcomer's voyage takes one auction: the deposit locks 20 epochs and burns on spam. Forging 1,000 identities takes 1,000 winning bids, at least 50,000 POA, earning nothing. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns it back in 30 days of fees.
